voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Scottish Highlands, seventeen forty-six. Weeks after Culloden, two French ships landed gold on the west coast for the Jacobite cause.
The rising was already lost. Seven caskets came ashore. One was stolen almost at once.
The other six were carried inland and hidden near Loch Arkaig. Only a few men knew where.
Some reached Bonnie Prince Charlie in France. Over the rest, his followers accused one another.
Gold coins later turned up in nearby woods. Some say the rest was gone long ago. If it is still there, it has never been found.
